modules.name: Modular Pedestrian Refuge Island
modules.description: A modular protected waiting area that allows pedestrians to cross a road in stages.
constraints: Requires adequate road width
Must maintain vehicle clearance
Final dimensions require site verification

modules.name: Solar Safety Bollard
modules.description: A modular high-visibility bollard with solar-powered lighting intended to improve pedestrian-zone visibility and discourage vehicle intrusion.
constraints: Placement must not obstruct pedestrian movement
Adequate spacing and vehicle clearance must be verified
Solar charging requires suitable light exposure
Final placement requires site verification

modules.name: Raised Crossing Module
modules.description: A raised pedestrian crossing concept intended to improve crossing visibility and encourage lower vehicle speeds at pedestrian conflict points.
constraints: Road geometry and drainage must be verified
Must not create unsafe vehicle transitions
Accessibility requirements must be reviewed
Final dimensions and placement require engineering verification

modules.name: Modular Accessibility Ramp
modules.description: A modular ramp system intended to provide step-free access across small level differences in pedestrian environments.
constraints: Required gradient must be verified before installation
Landing space and clear width must be verified
Surface must provide adequate slip resistance
Final design must comply with applicable accessibility requirements

modules.name: Tactile Guidance Path
modules.description: A modular tactile paving path intended to assist people with visual impairments in navigating pedestrian spaces.
constraints: Guidance path layout must be verified on site
Warning and directional tactile surfaces must be used appropriately
Installation must not introduce trip hazards
Final layout must comply with applicable accessibility requirements

modules.name: Accessible Walkway Module
modules.description: A modular pedestrian pathway intended to create a clearer, more accessible walking route through areas with inadequate pedestrian infrastructure.
constraints: Available clear width must be verified
Surface levels and drainage must be assessed
Route must remain free from fixed obstructions
Final dimensions require site and accessibility verification

modules.name: Solar Shade Canopy
modules.description: A modular shade structure intended to provide weather protection and improve comfort in exposed pedestrian waiting and public areas.
constraints: Structural stability and anchoring must be verified
Placement must maintain adequate pedestrian clearance
Solar panel orientation requires suitable sunlight exposure
Underground utilities and site conditions must be checked before installation

modules.name: Modular Bench
modules.description: A modular public seating unit intended to provide accessible resting space in pedestrian and community areas.
constraints: Must not obstruct the pedestrian clear path
Placement should provide adequate surrounding circulation space
Ground surface must support secure installation
Accessibility of the surrounding area should be considered

modules.name: Planter Barrier
modules.description: A modular planted barrier intended to help separate pedestrian areas from vehicle movement while introducing greenery into public space.
constraints: Must not obstruct pedestrian visibility or movement
Plant selection must suit local environmental conditions
Drainage and maintenance requirements must be considered
Must not be treated as a certified crash-protection barrier

modules.name: Permeable Paver Module
modules.description: A modular permeable paving system intended to create a walkable surface while allowing stormwater to infiltrate through the pavement.
constraints: Existing soil and drainage conditions must be assessed
Sub-base design must suit expected loads
Installation must not redirect runoff toward buildings or unsafe areas
Final drainage design requires site verification

modules.name: Modular Rain Garden
modules.description: A planted modular landscape feature intended to temporarily collect and manage surface runoff while adding greenery to public space.
constraints: Runoff source and flow direction must be verified
Overflow routing must be provided where required
Plant selection must suit local climate and maintenance capacity
Underground utilities and nearby structures must be checked

modules.name: Surface Drainage Channel
modules.description: A modular surface drainage channel intended to collect and guide runoff away from localized waterlogging areas toward an appropriate drainage destination.
constraints: A safe drainage outlet must be identified
Required channel capacity and slope must be verified
Grating must remain safe for pedestrian movement
Installation must not transfer flooding to another location
